paragraphs: Respondus describes its products as assessment tools for learning systems, and the site splits them into solutions for higher education and solutions for K-12. The company states that each year hundreds of millions of exams use LockDown Browser and Respondus Monitor to ensure academic integrity at educational institutions. Respondus 4 and StudyMate Campus create exam questions, self-assessments and learning games across thousands of universities and school districts.

Respondus technology is also embedded in 70+ third-party assessment platforms, ranging from homework systems to certification testing. The site groups that side of the business under partnerships and SDK, and lists learning system partners on the home page. The same page states that Respondus has been a pioneer of online testing for two decades.
